mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% annualized over the previous month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized growth > 2% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous three months signals a tightening labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals increased demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous month signals increased economic activity, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with increased economic activity.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the previous month signals robust consumer demand and employment growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint increase in RSAFS and PAYEMS does not correlate with positive market returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points over the previous month signals a loosening monetary policy, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with loosening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous month signals a strengthening labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint movement in PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with positive market returns.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the previous quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 decrease does not correlate with economic contraction.
